build_mmmu_dataset_from_args: build a MMMU dataset instance from argparse Namespace with num_prompts, backend, and random_output_len
create_sample_mmmu_requests: create sampled MMMU Math dataset requests with a processor, backend, and optional fixed output length
load_mmmu_dataset: load and sample MMMU Math dataset examples into DatasetRow objects using a HuggingFace processor
run_mmmu_benchmark: run a benchmark on the MMMU Math dataset by sampling prompts with images and generating text responses
test_mmmu_image_processing: test the MMMU dataset image processing pipeline that converts RGBA images to RGB and encodes them as base64 PNG
